protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: Confirmed. At vulnerable nef commit 5ce35eab62b49b46c02be55d0c8ab23ce0300bee, PfdChangeNotifier.FlushNotifications invokes NnefPFDmanagementNotify for the stored notifyUri and calls logger.PFDManageLog.Fatal(err) on delivery failure. PFDManageLog is a *logrus.Entry; logrus v1.9.3 Entry.Fatal calls Logger.Exit(1), so an unreachable attacker-controlled callback terminates NEF rather than containing the asynchronous error.
